full_judgment:
Md Ashfaqul Islam: This is an application under section 5 of the limitation Act for condonation of delay. From the order sheet it appears that the Customs Appeal No.04 of 2010 has been f led before; this Division on 09-2-20 I 0 against the Order dated 21-10-2009 passed by the Commissioner. Customs Excise and VAT (Appeal) and President, Review Committee which was out of time by 17 days. The appellant Commissioner of Customs has now filed this application for condonation of delay of 17 days. 

 3. The law is well settled that under a special law where a time limit has been given to file an appeal, the provision of section 5 of Limitation Act will not apply and the Customs Act being a Special law the provisions of section 5 of the Limitation Act shall not apply for condoning the delay in filling appeal under section 960 of the Act.
